context: A retired exec advises on growth
purpose: Teach: 東証/スミス/代目/号線/密着/遠藤/田村/高田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 東証上場、若い頃の私の夢でもあった。
lines.en: A Tokyo Stock Exchange listing — that was a dream of mine when I was young too.
lines.style: Unhurried, reflective. Slight pause between clauses as if retrieving the memory. Warm but distant, like watching something beautiful from across a room. Quiet satisfaction underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 三代目で実現、感慨深いです。
lines.en: Realizing it under the third generation — that's deeply moving.
lines.style: Composed but sincere. Light emphasis on 「実現」 — weight of accomplishment. Brief pause before the final phrase. Formal register but genuine warmth beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: スミス証券との関係、密着しすぎず、距離を保て。
lines.en: With Smith Securities — don't get too close. Maintain distance.
lines.style: Measured, careful. Each clause deliberate and weighted. Not harsh, but unmistakably firm. The tone of someone who has seen alliances shift. Slight pause between the warning and the instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 遠藤、田村、高田、皆若手として鍛えています。
lines.en: Endo, Tamura, Takada — I'm training all of them as rising talent.
lines.style: Steady, confident. Light pride in the enumeration of names. Even pace, no rushing. The assurance of someone building something that will outlast him. Matter-of-fact but grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 本社移転、号線アクセスより、人材の通勤を考えろ。
lines.en: For the headquarters move — prioritize staff commute over route access.
lines.style: Final wisdom, delivered simply. No grandstanding. Slight emphasis on 「通勤」 — the human cost matters more than logistics. Pause at the end, letting the priority settle in. The weight of lived experience.
